newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius' United Docks profit up 8.6 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius' United Docks profit up 8.6 percent.

text.p: Mauritian investment-based company United Docks posted on Monday an 8.6 percent rise in pre-tax profit for the financial year ending June 30 from the previous year.
Company officials said pre-tax profit increased to 25.2 million rupees from 23.2 million rupees.
Profit after tax of United Docks rose to 21.6 million rupees from 18.8 million rupees. Turnover was 10 percent higher to 36.0 million rupees from 32.7 million rupees.
"The value of the company's portfolio of local investments has been affected by the poor performance of shares on the stock exchange," said United Docks' General Manager Michel Rivalland.

"However, the group's overseas portfolio has benefited both from the recovery of the United States and European economies and also from the depreciation of the local currency vis a vis strong currencies like the dollar and British pound," he added.
Rivalland said United Docks' 1996/97 performance would be comparable to the previous financial year.
"It is felt that both the group and the company will achieve a reasonable level of profitability at least comparable to the current financial year," he said.
